title: Nvidia Developing New AI Chips for China Using Groq Technology; Availability Could Come As Early As May: Report - Baidu (NASDAQ:BIDU), NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA)
summary: Nvidia is developing new AI chips for China using Groq technology, with potential availability in May, as reported by Reuters. These chips are not downgraded versions for China and are adaptable for different systems. Nvidia continues to navigate export restrictions and aims to serve the competitive AI inference market in China.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses Nvidia's strategic move to develop new AI chips for China amidst export controls and competition, which carries a negative sentiment due to the implications of navigating trade restrictions and the competitive market.
